items.title: The shows
items.text: Roku bought the content rights on January 8, 2021 and relaunched the library in May 2021 as Roku Originals, free with advertising on The Roku Channel.[^17] It has since ordered second seasons of some of them.[^17] Most of the Daily Essentials news and lifestyle programmes were not part of the deal.[^16]

items.title: Turnstyle
items.text: The rotate-to-reframe technology and its intellectual property went to Eko in September 2021 under the settlement of the lawsuit. No money changed hands, according to Variety’s source.[^21]

items.title: The company
items.text: The app stopped streaming on or about December 1, 2020.[^15] The remaining entity, QBI Holdings LLC, existed in 2021 to settle the Eko case.[^21] We found nothing operating under the Quibi name today, and could not load quibi.com in October 2026.

items.title: The investors
items.text: About $350 million of the $1.75 billion was reportedly returned.[^16] Whitman described closing with cash in the bank as the alternative to what most entrepreneurs do, which is to “keep on going because they literally run out of money.”[^2]

items.title: The staff
items.text: About 200 people worked at Quibi when it closed. They were told at a virtual town hall on October 21, 2020.[^2][^32]

items.title: The founders
items.text: Meg Whitman was confirmed as United States ambassador to Kenya in July 2022.[^37] Katzenberg’s holding company WndrCo, which incubated Quibi, predates it.[^4]

items.title: The Emmys
items.text: Quibi won two Emmys in September 2020, both for #FreeRayshawn.[^23] In July 2021 former Quibi shows earned eight nominations, credited to Roku.[^20]

blocks.title: From NewTV to Roku Originals
blocks.subtitle: The name lasted two years. The shows and the technology went to different owners.

nodes.what: Katzenberg’s venture raises its first $1 billion.[^3][^4]
Renamed for “quick bites.”[^28] A second round in March 2020 takes funding to $1.75 billion.[^3]
The founders announce the closure and put the content and technology up for sale. Streaming ends on or about December 1.[^1][^15]
Buys the content rights to more than 75 shows.[^16][^17]
Receives the Turnstyle technology in a settlement with QBI Holdings.[^21]
The shows carry Roku’s brand. Nothing we found uses the Quibi name.[^17]

blocks.source: Variety[^3][^16][^21], Roku’s 10-K for fiscal 2021[^17], the founders’ letter[^1]. Quibi was not bankrupt; it wound down voluntarily and returned cash. The chain marks the wind-down in the same style as a failure for clarity.
